Disseminations of Reports / Inflated trending topic pairs Sinar Mas criticism with OJK cleanup praise

Inflated trending topic pairs Sinar Mas criticism with OJK cleanup praise

Published 25 October 2026

Ishak Martins, Adisty Ramadhani

Lokanetra Information Observatory

#SangsiSinarMasGroupdenda emiten oligarki#PrajogoPengestuDidendaDSSA

Download PDF

Introduction

We have detected a burst of inflated trending topic attacking specifically Sinar Mas Group and crediting it to a "clean-up effort" of the Otoritas Jasa Keuangan.

Findings

  • The hashtag set paired #SangsiSinarMasGroup (654 tweets) with #OJKbersihbersih (640) and #PrajogoPengestuDidenda (639). Top words were denda (939), emiten (873), dssa (754), oligarki (696) and ojk (625).
  • Posting peaked at 19/10/2026 16:00 GMT+7 with 664 tweets in one hour. The dataset records 10 burst hours.
  • The 903 accounts produced 838 original tweets, 370 replies and 77 quotes. Top accounts by tweet count: vitaAVP 60, dittaprastiwi 24, ViralinAJ4 19, lexa1429 16, jomaenSaham 12, ArmaZulfikar 12, mantantermul01 11, omataya 11, spiritgw12 8 and SETYAKI22965702 8.
  • Evidence tiers over 903 accounts: T0 159 (No signals), T1 157 (Burst participation), T2 587 (Metadata-suspicious), T3 0 (Coordinated).
  • Emotion labels on 128 tweets with the highest reactions: Anger 44.5%, Disgust 31.2%, Surprise 16.4%, Anticipation 11.7%, Joy 10.2%, Trust 10.2%, Fear 5.5%, Sadness 3.1%. A tweet can carry several labels.

Remarks

The dataset covers one week and 1,285 tweets. It labels 128 tweets for emotion and gives evidence tiers for 903 accounts. The tiers record metadata signals and burst participation in this dataset; they do not establish automation, payment or coordination. Watch the next hashtag wave, the accounts that post in the burst hours and any change in the T2 count.

Amplification

Source: Kestrel Parts D and E. 903 accounts. Tiers describe evidence found in this dataset. They are not a claim that an account is automated, paid or coordinated.

Evidence tiers

Accounts per evidence tier

T0No signals
159 accounts, 18%

Nothing in this corpus separates this account from ordinary participation.

T1Burst participation only
157 accounts, 17%

The account posted inside an amplification burst and nothing else fired. Never filtered: posting during a spike is what an interested human does too.

T2Metadata-suspicious
587 accounts, 65%

At least two independent evidence families fired (burst-exclusive posting, creation inside a creation burst, extreme profile metadata, high near-duplicate/self-repetition).

T3Coordinated
0 accounts, 0%

This account sits in a cluster that stayed outside the permutation null after FDR correction. The strongest evidence tier, and the only one the de-amplified corpus removes by default.
